transcript.text: I need to flag something important before we go further. During a camera-rail test I ran, I confirmed that the rotating platform as specified in the current draft would enter the camera rail's required three-meter exclusion lane. The technically approved layout actually calls for a fixed platform with a three-meter camera lane, not a rotating platform with a two-meter lane. I recorded this in the technical log, but I haven't yet updated Mara's design draft to reflect it. So the draft you're all looking at right now doesn't match what passed technical testing.

transcript.text: I need to flag a critical location issue. I confirmed with the Atrium Theater's preservation officer this morning that drilling into the theater floor is prohibited. The approved replacement requires exactly 18 ballast bases for a freestanding platform. I have the written restriction, but it hasn't been added to the location packet yet, so none of you would have seen this. This directly affects the floor anchors called for in the current draft.
